event_description: Triggered when a user logs in to a customer or partner portal, including epilot or partner users logging in as the customer (`is_admin_login`). Carries the portal user, its primary contact, the related contacts and the accounts of the primary contact.

json_schema.description: ID of the portal user entity
ID of the portal the user belongs to (end customer portal or partner portal)
Login email address of the portal user
ID of the primary contact the portal user is mapped to. Absent while the portal user is not mapped to a contact
Whether this is the first login of the portal user. Always false for admin logins

is_first_login.graph_source: portal_user.first_login and portal_user.last_login ? portal_user.first_login = portal_user.last_login : false

json_schema.description: Whether an epilot or partner user logged in as the customer ("login as") rather than the customer
ID of the epilot or partner user who logged in as the customer. Only for admin logins
Email of the user who logged in as the customer. Only for admin logins; absent when they used an API token
Organization of the user who logged in as the customer: a partner organization when it differs from `_org_id`. Only for admin logins
